stem.text: A particular atom of germanium, $\text{Ge}$, has a nucleon number of 70.
Which statements about a ${}^{70}_{32}\text{Ge}$ atom are correct?

items: It has the same number of electrons as a ${}^{79}_{34}\text{Se}^{2+}$ ion.
It has the same number of neutrons as an atom of ${}^{68}_{30}\text{Zn}$.
It has half as many protons as an atom of ${}^{160}_{64}\text{Gd}$.
